items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: to a saxophone (of course I had played it before) was when Bix Beiderbecke came out with "Singin' The Blues," with Frankie Trumbauer playing that C-melody.

ctx.x: Listening to you talk, you say that you got pretty early on the saxophone, and all that stuff. Did most of the clarinet players drop their clarinets when the saxophone became popular, or did some of them...?
No, a lot of them doubled. But it seems to me... I was fascinated with the saxophone then. I was just crazy about it. And really the guy that turned me on
